verdict.rationale: Lighthouse's pricing documents employer-side features for multiple hires: candidate progress reports, consolidated billing, compliance support and workforce pathway planning. It also states it handles the petitions, timelines and compliance "behind every hire", so a growing team can run its visas through one provider. Missing for 10: detail on how multi-case tracking works across hires (e.g., an employer dashboard), any explicitly named startup/scale-up program, independent or hands-on corroboration; and the key team features sit in the Plus tier.

support.subject: As a hiring manager, I can run visas for a growing team through one provider — multi-case management or a stated startup/scale-up program beyond single founder cases
